{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01G3gxU66YyznAz8sB3vHd3e","type":"tool_result","content":"* develop\n  feat/BKG-95\nPlease make sure you have the correct access rights\nand the repository exists.\nSwitched to branch 'feat/BKG-95'\n518393e fix(remind): 引数の数を確かめる (#95)\n238336e feat(remind): 予約が無い日は no bookings を出す (#95)\n178b642 roombook: initial import\n---\n#!/bin/bash\n# remind.sh DATE: one reminder per booking of the day, from the listing.\nset -u\nif [ $# -ne 1 ]; then echo \"usage: remind.sh DATE\"; exit 2; fi\nout=$(bash \"$(dirname \"$0\")/list.sh\" \"$1\")\nif [ -z \"$out\" ]; then echo \"no bookings: $1\"; exit 0; fi\nprintf '%s\\n' \"$out\" | while read -r d t r w; do echo \"reminder to $w: $r $d $t\"; done\n---\n#!/bin/bash\nfail=0\nt=$(mktemp); printf '# h\\naoi\\t2026-01-01\\t10:00\\t11:00\\tx\\n' > \"$t\"\n[ \"$(BOOKINGS=$t bash src/remind.sh 2026-01-02)\" = 'no bookings: 2026-01-02' ] || { echo \"a day without bookings\"; fail=1; }\nbash src/remind.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $?
